unresolved_verification_issues: No independent specialist review, experimental replication or reanalysis of source data.
Several auxiliary sources retain clearly labeled wiki-inherited access; they are not claimed as newly verified.
Full ISO standards and full proprietary ASBC methods were not accessed; only public scopes/explanations support these lessons.
Selected original papers were accessed as abstracts and indexed excerpts, not complete papers or supplementary data.
Species-level identification and functional predictions in umqombothi study not independently revalidated.
Future climate and engineering model outcomes remain conditional; case-study footprints were not recalculated.

revision_record.result: Exactly 33 distinct focal discoveries, numbers 35–67; boundaries coordinated with history and culture agents.

Core named studies, dates, designs, mechanisms and claims checked against primary abstracts, selected full text or institutional explanations as individually logged. Quantitative operating settings and sweeping claims omitted.
Sake and tapé retain identities; experimental systems not promoted to universal traditions; kveik isolates distinguished from maintained cultures; no European standard used to grade other traditions.
Varied openings, concrete comparisons, defined terminology; repeated broader-lesson signposting removed; no quotations.
Progression from grain to metabolism, evolution/ecology, chemistry, perception, materials and environmental systems; selective internal callbacks.
Headings, numbering, one note per lesson and complete note definitions checked locally; final EPUB/PDF validation belongs to root production pass.
